description: Change a commerce pricing policy. Only the fields you send change; rules replace the whole rule list. policy_id is the id from list_commerce_policies. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

approval_mode.description: manual queues every proposal for a decision, auto approves small changes, shadow records proposals without acting on them.

auto_approve_max_delta_pct.description: With approval_mode auto: proposals that move the price by at most this percent skip the queue. Required for auto.

ceiling_price.description: No proposal goes above this price.

floor_price.description: No proposal goes below this price.

is_active.description: Whether the pipeline applies the policy.

policy_id.description: The policy id, as list_commerce_policies gives it.

rules.description: The rules, tried in order; the first that produces a price wins. Each rule has an id, a kind and the fields its kind needs: a percent to undercut by, an amount to beat the lowest price by, a percent off the list price, a competitor to match, a fixed price, or a routing choice. The Pricing Policies section of the documentation lists them.

scope.description: Which items the policy covers: skus, brands and marketplaces lists. Empty covers every item.

name: update_commerce_policy
